semantic_units.judgment: The English and Korean original ask which TS Sections the named RedCap study affected. TS plus Section identity is required. The original trTitle, impactType and impactDescription remain diagnostic context; requiring those optional projected columns would add obligations.

The original Phase5 design CQ3 seeks comprehensive technology-study influence. Actual TR38.875 Scope and conclusions describe the study and recommendations; twelve source specification-impact analyses include conditional and prospective effects. The author's explicit manual-mapping caution supports examining actual amendments, rather than accepting an earlier syntactic PASS as semantic validation.

ROOT directly reopened eleven original document/styles pairs. Actual CR2112935 introduces TS38.213 sections17/17.1/17.2, while its frozen clausesAffected and Section roles are absent. CR2112954 supports TS38.214 section6.1.2.1; CR2401911/12 positively amend TS38.211 section5.3.2. These positives are accepted irrespective of explicit TR-number citation or latest-release Section loading. Candidate WorkItem correspondence is useful discovery, while a mixed CR's entire clause set needs attributable amendment roles before being treated as this study's complete effect set.

Distinct TS Section identities are the answer units. ROOT actual immutable SQL verifies the original and inverse two-row projection, three manual impact assertions, ten same-number cross-release nodes and 137 named-core CRs spanning78 Section IDs. Neither CR mirrors nor duplicated history create extra study effects; none of those diagnostic cardinalities is used as an answer oracle.

The original complete set cannot be certified by returning its two joined assertions: the third manual assertion has no retained target Section, and directly reopened positive introduction source supplies additional Sections including a different TS. ROOT additionally replayed all nine complete captured SQL roles and independently scanned every frozen node's decoded string properties, reproducing all146 semantic CR candidates. These recoveries establish actual partial effects and preserve further candidates; their union does not establish complete same-study Section attribution under the preserved scope.

There is no top-N request. The actual query orders by sectionId and has no LIMIT. Preserve that deterministic original ordering for any future complete contract. No default10, initial-only, latest-only or arbitrary ancestor granularity is introduced.
